reason: The master catalog has no UBASH3A-locus model. Public indexed original long-read alignments allow a bounded locus audit independent of that catalog.
known_at_freeze: 13 annotation files scanned; TRAILS has one exact plus29 model with a different terminal exon and 247 source count units, 157 across CD4 subsets. No NMD target counts or individual long-read alignments inspected. One control BAM HEAD established advertised byte ranges.
cell_context: Engineered HCT116 N-AID-UPF1; a transfer test, not primary CD4 validation.
replication: Two source-labeled culture replicates per condition and platform. Analyze platforms separately; they are not independent donors. Replicate numbers alone do not prove paired culture blocks.
fetch_scope: Header and pre-existing Ensembl UBASH3A interval only. Require HTTP 206 on a 64-KiB prefix probe, indexed extraction, and unchanged source size/ETag/Last-Modified before and after extraction. Retain all fetched alignments in small BAMs with subset/index/header hashes. Whole source BAMs are not downloaded or whole-file hashed.
read_quality: Primary mapped alignments, excluding secondary, supplementary, QC-failed and duplicate-flagged records, with MAPQ >=20. Save every record and exclusion reason. Unflagged PCR duplicates can remain; counts are reads, not unique molecules.
junction_rule: CIGAR N defines junctions. Use exact one-based last-exonic-base/next-exonic-base coordinates and >=20 consecutive aligned M/= /X bases immediately on each side of each evaluated N. Insertions/deletions interrupt an anchor. Nearby donors, D operations and retained introns are not plus29.
chain_rule: Primary full-chain assignment requires every internal junction to exactly match a frozen normal/plus29 reference, >=20-base anchors at every junction, aligned reference coding-start base, and all three predicted stop bases aligned for plus29. Terminal outer coordinates may differ and are reported. Separately report downstream-only chain coverage without naming it a full reference transcript.
primary_comparison: Report each sample and every reference. Compare boundary ENST00000398367.2 versus the shared canonical/ENST00001131803.1 downstream architecture; retain other models separately and avoid duplicate counting when reference matches overlap.
estimation: Descriptive only. Within each platform, aggregate reads across the two cultures in each arm while retaining sample counts. If all normal/plus29 counts in both conditions and architectures are positive, compute log2 treated-versus-control change in retained:normal odds for each architecture and boundary-minus-canonical difference. The hypothesis predicts a negative difference. No pseudocount, P value or pooling across platforms. Zeros, incomplete structures and low coverage remain visible; unavailable effects are not estimable, never zero response.
interpretation: UPF1 abundance response is not a direct half-life, specific NMD proof, CD4 validation or protein detection. Non-detection in this extraction is not general biological absence.
